summary: Iteration 8 — validated new admin features: user management, dynamic settings, admin-level audit deletion, change-password, dynamic landing pricing, and regression on audit creation + document upload. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests pass. Frontend: 7/7 Playwright flows pass. All state restored (admin password OnBuy2026!, price_small=1100).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1087 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, audits, admin, documents) to keep files under ~700 lines per code review guideline.
GET /api/admin/users triggers N+1 count_documents queries per user (2 per user). For scale, consider MongoDB aggregation with $lookup or precomputed counters.

public_settings and admin_get_settings both fully call get_app_settings; masking is done by popping llm_key from the returned dict — verify get_app_settings does not return a shared mutable reference (would cause the mutation to leak across requests). Currently OK if it returns a fresh dict each call.
Email normalization (lower/strip) is done in register/login but tests should be aware — good code, just document.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/test_admin_features.py must be run with `-n 0` (serial) because loadscope-based xdist causes duplicate email registration between workers (same module-scoped fixture). Consider migrating to per-worker unique emails or moving fixtures to session scope with xdist compatibility if you need parallel runs.
